facts.answer: XYZ Forge prevents multiple unattended AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, agy) from becoming a repository race condition or silently damaging code. As a local-first operations system with zero servers or coordination API keys, it supplies the deterministic operational safeguards unattended runs fail without: upfront task specification and runnable-gate preflight, collision-free path-scoped lanes, disposable-worktree and allowlist turn containment with budget/resource caps and no agent push path, deterministic test and doc-contract gates, and a receipted ledger of landed work.

facts.answer: Issue GH-148 in `acme-payments` (preventing duplicate Stripe webhook retries from double-charging accounts) becomes a capture doc at `PROJECT/1-INBOX/GH-148-webhook-idempotency.md` with a verification contract (`npm test -- test/webhooks.test.ts`), declared write set (`billing/webhooks.ts`, `test/webhooks.test.ts`), and 4-axis PRS rating (`pri`, `sev`, `appeal`, `effort`). The wave planner schedules it concurrently with disjoint work (`billing/invoices.ts`) while deferring overlapping `billing/webhooks.ts` tasks to the next wave, and preflight writes a schema-stamped `preflight.json` confirming freshness and that the gate starts before turn 1. In Relay execution (`relay-turn-lib.sh`), `tick` takes an `O_EXCL` path-scoped claim in `.tick/events/`, the builder edits in a throwaway worktree under `$3.00`/40-turn caps plus watchdog and mid-turn commit-reset guards, a second reviewer model critiques under `$1.50`/20-turn and tighter allowlist rules, and only allowlisted files (`billing/webhooks.ts`, `test/webhooks.test.ts`) copy back with zero push path from turn shims. Finally, the verification gate runs `webhooks.test.ts` under CPU/wall/RSS caps (exiting 108 on runaway), PDDA checks `PROJECT/**` frontmatter, status tables, and ledger alignment, the PRS ledger writes a verified receipt, and the operator lands and pushes behind local pre-push hooks.

facts.answer: A support issue reporting that `export --format csv` outputs an empty file on zero rows (when the importer expects a header) is linked to a project capture doc, given explicit acceptance criteria (one header line on empty exports; existing output preserved when rows exist), and rated on priority, severity, appeal, and effort in the release ledger.
